31844.note: Quick-service Cuban counter near Ybor City built around flan, with a second stall at Armature Works; closed Mondays.

32001.note: Colombian restaurant with an attached cafe and bakery on North Armenia Avenue.

32036.note: Seminole Heights Cuban cafe listed on the tourism bureau's Cuban sandwich page, known for a mustard-mayo pressed Cuban.

32097.note: Ybor City Argentine-Peruvian grill from chef Nelson Umaña known for churrasco.

32122.note: Ybor City raw bar from Barterhouse owner Ken Emery with daily oyster happy hour; dinner Tuesday to Sunday.
32122.fn: Creative Loafing reported it opened Sept. 10, 2025.

32131.note: Ybor City corner bar and restaurant serving Tampa's Cuban-Italian-Spanish standbys like Cuban sandwiches, deviled crab and bean soup.

32145.note: Block-long Spanish-Cuban dining hall in Ybor City, run by the founding family and known for its tiled rooms, flamenco show and Tampa-style Cuban.
32145.fn: The restaurant says Casimiro Hernandez Sr. founded it in 1905 in a 1903 corner saloon that is part of today's block-long Ybor building; it calls itself "Florida's Oldest Restaurant℠" (its service mark, an attributed claim).

32170.note: Ybor City Cuban bread bakery, still family-run, that supplies loaves to many Tampa Cuban-sandwich counters and runs a cafe at the bakery.
32170.fn: The bakery dates itself to 1915 (founder Juan Moré) and marked its 110th anniversary in July 2025, while a 2025 story it links notes the exact founding year is uncertain; no source confirmed when baking began at this address.

32252.note: South Tampa steakhouse famous for its huge wine cellar and upstairs Harry Waugh Dessert Room, with wine lists dated 2026.
32252.fn: Bern's says it was founded in 1956 and created from a business block on Howard Avenue that held a grocery, barber shop and dime store; it marks its 70th anniversary in 2026.

32379.note: West Tampa sandwich counter pressing Tampa-style Cubans with salami, plus a version brushed with honey on top that it calls the Obama Cuban.
32379.fn: Earlier coverage says it has served Cuban sandwiches from this Armenia Avenue storefront for 30-plus years; no exact year confirmed.

32528.note: West Tampa Colombian restaurant on Columbus Drive, in business for more than a quarter century.
32528.fn: Creative Loafing (June 2025) says it has served Colombian food for over 25 years.

32534.note: Long-running two-story West Tampa Cuban restaurant with an adjacent cantina, open from 6 a.m., known for its café con leche and Cuban plates.
32534.fn: The restaurant's site says it was established in 1972; it did not say whether it has always been at this address.

32638.note: South Tampa cafe outpost of the Ybor bread bakery, serving its Cuban sandwiches, pastries and coffee.

33934.note: Seminole Heights cafe outpost of the Ybor bread bakery with its Cuban sandwiches, pastries and coffee.
